INGEST_TOKEN.description: Paste the private site key from [AI Tracker](https://ai-tracker.smol.capital) → your site → Site key. Not a Cloudflare API key.

TRACKED_HOST.description: Required: the exact lowercase hostname for that site key, e.g. example.com. No https://, path, wildcard or port. Add its route after deploying.

AI_TRACKER_URL.description: Dashboard HTTPS origin. Leave https://ai-tracker.smol.capital unless you host your own AI Tracker dashboard.
